leadText:
Mrs. Ripple (Japanese: リップル Ripple) is a character of the day who appeared in Cilan and the Case of the Purrloin Witness!.

Mrs. Ripple is a jewel collector from Unova who displayed her collection on a cruiseship. Another jewel collector, a named Mr. Shaw, came up and showed great interest in one of her rare jewels, called the "Eye of ", and started making offers for it. Naturally, however, Mrs. Ripple declined each time. Other examples in her collection include " 's Tear", " 's Bloom", and "Star of ".

After the Marine Cup Tournament, Mrs. Ripple found out that the Eye of Liepard had been stolen from her collection. She accused Mr. Shaw of stealing it, since he was shown to have broken in to her room on the security camera. However, upon further inspection, it was revealed that when Mr. Shaw entered the room, the Eye of Liepard was already taken; he only trespassed for the purpose of getting another look at it. Mrs. Ripple and Mr. Shaw came to good terms after the real criminal was revealed to be a participant in the tournament, named Teaque.
